_note: Terrain horizon for own coordinates (ADR 0106, revisits ADR 0037). scripts/terrain_coarse.py writes block-mean copies of the two LOLA south-polar grids of config/horizon.json into data/terrain/ (16-bit little-endian, height = DN * dn_scale_m above moon_radius_m, south pole at the grid centre). The page loads them only when an own point lies at or south of lat_max, once per page, and casts the same rays as scripts/horizon.py (ray settings from config/horizon.json) in a Web Worker. Finest grid first. scripts/terrain_gate.mjs measures the agreement with the 80 m profiles (data/horizon/) at every listed site that has one; gate_pct is the share of hours in which both answers (Sun up, Earth up) must agree.
_note_cache: Skylines kept in memory per page (most recent own points); older ones are computed again when chosen.
